**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User is planning to buy a new moisturizer from Sephora.  
[PREFERENCE] User has combination skin and their main concern is dehydration.

[EVENT] User decided to go with the La Roche-Posay moisturizer.  
[PREFERENCE] User inquired about earning points for purchasing the moisturizer at Sephora.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant noted that purchasing the La Roche-Posay moisturizer priced at around $30 would bring the user closer to redeeming a free skincare product.
